text: Android: a long amount overflows toCents and crashes the list screen for every member

Landed. Amounts are bounded to 13 whole digits in all three places — Kotlin, web and the server's PRICE_AMOUNT_RE — chosen as the widest value that can never exceed JS's MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, so both clients stay exact rather than merely not throwing; the server's length pre-check drops 32 -> 20. Shared table gained a boundary case and a to_cents_invalid group. Note this tightens a wire rule: an amount wider than 13 digits is now refused on push (stored oversized values are unaffected and now parse to no value instead of crashing).
